description: UAT fixtures on gitlab.com for the authenticated smoke tier. Created idempotently by tests/fixtures/seed_fixtures.mjs (make seed-fixtures) with a token that has the api scope; the read-only provider then queries them back. Group and project paths can be overridden with GITLAB_SMOKE_GROUP / GITLAB_SMOKE_PROJECT.

group.name: StackQL
group.description: Read-only mirrors of StackQL repositories. The canonical source, issues, discussions and stars live on GitHub: https://github.com/stackql

subgroup.name: smoke
subgroup.description: Subgroup fixture for the stackql gitlab provider smoke suite (group_descendant_groups).

mirror.name: stackql
mirror.description: Read-only mirror of https://github.com/stackql/stackql, the canonical repository. Please star, open issues and contribute on GitHub.

smokeProject.name: stackql-provider-smoke
smokeProject.description: Fixture project for the stackql gitlab provider smoke suite: labels, milestones, issues, a merge request, a release, CI variables, an environment and a board, queried back read-only.

issues.title: smoke: bug report
issues.description: A fixture issue with a label, milestone and weight.

issues.title: smoke: closed issue
issues.description: A fixture issue that is closed.

mergeRequest.title: smoke: feature merge request
mergeRequest.description: Fixture MR from smoke-feature to main; left open.
